title: 045 - Pagination Offset
prompt: Fix the bug so the program calculate the offset for page 3 with page size 20 and print 40 and prints exactly `40`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
hint: The page number should be converted to a zero-based offset first.
explanation: The broken formula multiplies the page directly. Subtracting 1 from the page before multiplying fixes the offset.
